neet_phy_u05_t01_1.working: From rest, θ = ½αt² = ½ × 2 × 5² = 25 rad.

neet_phy_u05_t01_2.working: Tangential acceleration a_t = αr = 3 m/s². Centripetal acceleration a_c = ω²r = 4 m/s². They are perpendicular, so a = √(3² + 4²) = 5 m/s².

neet_phy_u05_t01_3.working: All particles of a rigid body share the same ω. Since v = ωr, Q at 2r has twice P's linear speed.

neet_phy_u05_t01_4.working: Tangential acceleration is αr (II). Centripetal acceleration is ω²r (I). Linear velocity is ω×r (IV). Angular displacement is ω₀t + ½αt² (III).

neet_phy_u05_t01_5.working: A is true: all particles share the same angular displacement. B is false: ω lies along the axis, not in the plane of rotation. C is true: tangential and centripetal accelerations are perpendicular. D is true: rolling is translation of the centre of mass plus rotation about it. E is false: a particle on the axis has zero speed. So A, C and D.
